code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Find the repeated isolated marker color: many singleton cells, distinct from
    # the compact source pattern. A compact connected component supplies pattern.
    candidates = []
    for color, n in counts.items():
        if color != bg and n > 1:
            pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
            # connected-component sizes
            unseen = set(pts); sizes=[]
            while unseen:
                start=unseen.pop(); q=[start]; size=1
                while q:
                    r,c=q.pop()
                    for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                        if p in unseen:
                            unseen.remove(p); q.append(p); size+=1
                sizes.append(size)
            if len(pts) >= 2 and max(sizes) <= 4:
                candidates.append((len(pts), color, pts))
    marker_color = max(candidates, default=(0,None,[]), key=lambda x:x[0])[1]
    if marker_color is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker_color]
    # Source shape is all non-background cells excluding marker points; crop to bbox.
    src = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker_color]
    if not src:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(x[0] for x in src); r1=max(x[0] for x in src)
    c0=min(x[1] for x in src); c1=max(x[1] for x in src)
    # Retain the full rectangular pattern, including background-colored cells.
    pattern={(r-r0,c-c0):grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)}
    # Anchor markers on the center of the source pattern.
    ar, ac=(r1-r0)//2, (c1-c0)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        for (dr,dc),v in pattern.items():
            rr,cc=r+dr-ar,c+dc-ac
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
